# Partiful — account brief

## Who
Partiful is a company whose GitHub org profile lists the website partiful.com ([source](https://github.com/partiful)). Its homepage describes it as "Partiful — Delightful, free party invites. Plan events and parties with friends." ([source](https://partiful.com/)).

## Production Expo signals
- `eas.json` is present in `partiful/mobile` ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/blob/main/eas.json)).
- `eas.json` is also present in `partiful-app/mobile-legacy` ([source](https://github.com/partiful-app/mobile-legacy/blob/main/eas.json)).
- `partiful/mobile/package.json` lists react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/blob/main/package.json)).
- `partiful/mobile` has CI workflows ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/tree/main/.github/workflows)).
- The `partiful` org has 12 public repos and 180 followers ([source](https://github.com/partiful)).
- `partiful/mobile` last pushed 2026-08-14 ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile)).
- The App Store listing has 41,200 ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/partiful/id1590736570)).
- There were 6 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/partiful/id1590736570)).
- An open issue reads "eas update rollout stuck at 0% for Android channel" ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/issues/61)).
- Partiful links a careers page from its homepage ([source](https://partiful.com/careers)).

## Who to talk to
- Maintainer One (@partiful-maintainer-1), top contributor to `partiful/mobile` with 142 commits ([source](https://github.com/partiful-maintainer-1)). Profile lists company "Partiful", location "Remote", website https://partiful.com, and bio "Mobile engineer at Partiful. Maintains the Partiful app (Expo / React Native)." ([source](https://github.com/partiful-maintainer-1)).
- Maintainer Two (@partiful-maintainer-2), top contributor to `partiful/mobile` with 87 commits ([source](https://github.com/partiful-maintainer-2)). Profile lists company "Partiful", location "New York, NY", website https://partiful.com, and bio "React Native developer on the Partiful mobile team. EAS builds and releases for the Partiful app." ([source](https://github.com/partiful-maintainer-2)).
- Maintainer Three (@partiful-maintainer-3), top contributor to `partiful/mobile` with 31 commits ([source](https://github.com/partiful-maintainer-3)). Profile lists company "Partiful", location "San Francisco, CA", website https://partiful.com, and bio "Engineer at Partiful. Mostly the Partiful app, sometimes the API." ([source](https://github.com/partiful-maintainer-3)).

## Why now
`partiful/mobile` last pushed 2026-08-14 ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile)), and the App Store listing shows 6 releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/partiful/id1590736570)). The repo runs react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/blob/main/package.json)).

## Suggested opener
Maintainer One, your profile says you maintain the Partiful app on Expo and React Native, and you have 142 commits to `partiful/mobile` ([source](https://github.com/partiful-maintainer-1)). The repo shipped 6 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/partiful/id1590736570)) and has an open issue titled "eas update rollout stuck at 0% for Android channel" ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/issues/61)). Is that Android rollout issue still blocking updates, and how are you currently working around it in your release flow?
